Fire Mage DPS Gear and Best in Slot — 12.1

OverallMythic+Raid

This list contains the highest DPS setup from all sources for Fire Mage. There are often many items for a single slot that are very close or even identical DPS, especially if you simply shuffle secondary stats around between different slots. Due to this, you should only use the list below as a general guideline of what a set of end-game gear looks like, not to make immediate gearing choices.

This list is by no means a replacement for simming yourself. Depending on your previous Great Vault choices and the gear you have available, your BiS gear might look different in some spots than the below list.

In a few slots, I list items from Mythic+, which can only be obtained at Mythic track from The Great Vault. Generally these items are only best-in-slot at Mythic track, not in their Heroic track variants. You are usually better off using a higher item level piece than the best-in-slot piece if you cannot obtain it at Mythic track.

FAQWhich Tier Set Pieces Do I Want?
In Season 2, Catalyst keeps the item level, stats and any special bonuses of an item, so it does not matter which 4 out of 5 slots you catalyze. Pick any 4 out of 5 you have available from the list below:
  • Head — Venomkeeper's Horrific Cowl
  • Shoulders — Ornaments of the Eternal Coil
  • Chest — Primordial Robe of Rites
  • Hands — Grasps of the Eternal Shadow
  • Legs — Initiate's Sacrificial Tights

Note: getting 4-set in any capacity is much more important than getting them on the correct (catalyzed) pieces, so always prioritize getting 4-set over the right pieces.

FAQWhat Items From the Great Vault Should I Pick?
Generally, you will want to focus on picking items that are the biggest upgrade for you by simming Top Gear. However, there are also some items in general that are very valuable and almost always worth picking up if you see them:
  • Jan'thrazet, the Soul Fang: Best-in-slot Weapon by a large margin and very rare and wanted by all casters, so always pick this up if it is in your vault in a Mythic slot (9/6 Myth track)
  • Any of the other 9/6 Myth track items listed below: All of them are best-in-slot for both Fire Mage and generally all other cloth wearers, so very difficult to obtain otherwise.
  • Vile Vial of Volatile Venom: Best-in-slot Trinket which can only be obtained at Myth track from The Great Vault.

This list contains the highest DPS setup with farmable gear from Season 2 Mythic+ Dungeons. This includes Tier pieces and 2 Embellished items due to their importance, even though they are not technically from Mythic+ Dungeons, since they are obtainable via The Great Vault / Catalyst / Crafting.

This list is by no means a replacement for simming yourself. Depending on your previous Great Vault choices and the gear you have available, your BiS gear might look different in some spots than the below list.

FAQWhich Tier Set Pieces Do I Want?
In Season 2, Catalyst keeps the item level, stats and any special bonuses of an item, so it does not matter which 4 out of 5 slots you catalyze. Pick any 4 out of 5 you have available from the list below:
  • Head — Overseer's Diadem
  • Shoulders — Mantle of Ceremonial Ascension
  • Chest — Hoarded Harvest Wrap
  • Hands — Counterfeit Clutches
  • Legs — Wind Soarer's Breeches

Note: getting 4-set in any capacity is much more important than getting them on the correct (catalyzed) pieces, so always prioritize getting 4-set over the right pieces.

TipsWhich Dungeons Should I Farm?
There are a few outstanding dungeons due to specific items dropping in them making them very good dungeons to farm:
  • Altar of Fangs: Drops both the best on-use trinkets ( Vile Vial of Volatile Venom), and the best non-raid Weapon.
  • Murder Row: Drops strong Neck, Hands and Feet, while even dropping some pretty decent Trinkets, making it a Dungeon with a very high likelihood of dropping something useful.
  • Blinding Vale: Drops two very strong passive trinkets, including the best non-raid trinket, while also dropping a great Cloak and multiple other useful pieces.

This list contains the highest DPS setup, only using gear from the Venomous Abyss Raid. This includes 2 Embellished items as well due to their importance.

This list is by no means a replacement for simming yourself. Depending on your previous Great Vault choices and the gear you have available to yourself, your BiS gear might look different than this list in some spots.

FAQWhich Tier Set Pieces Do I Want?
In Season 2, Catalyst keeps the item level, stats and any special bonuses of an item, so it does not matter which 4 out of 5 slots you catalyze. From Raid, the only chest piece available is Crest of the Primal Leywarden, which is a tier item, so you would always take that one. Then, pick any 3 out of 4 you have available from the list below to catalyze:
  • Head — Venomkeeper's Horrific Cowl
  • Shoulders — Ornaments of the Eternal Coil
  • Hands — Grasps of the Eternal Shadow
  • Legs — Initiate's Sacrificial Tights

Note: getting 4-set in any capacity is much more important than getting them on the correct (catalyzed) pieces, so always prioritize getting 4-set over the right pieces.

TipsWhat Raid Items Are Most Important?
If you need to submit a list of highly-important items to your raidleader, or simply want to focus on the most important bosses and items, we got you covered!
  • Jan'thrazet, the Soul Fang: The best weapon by a large margin, due to its higher item level and secondary effect.
  • Venomkeeper's Horrific Cowl: The best helm by a large margin, due to its higher item level and Venomcursed effect.
  • Gebbo's Bottomless Bag: The best passive trinket.

Trinket Recommendations for Fire Mage in Season 2

Ranking Trinkets
S Tier
  • Vile Vial of Volatile Venom — Best on-use Trinket
  • Gebbo's Bottomless Bag — Best passive Trinket
A Tier
  • Vexhul's Everflowing Gland — Strong on-use Trinket on single-target, but loses value on AoE.
  • Lightspire Core — Strong passive Trinket
  • Wavecaller's Seastone — Strong passive Trinket
B Tier
  • Hex Lord's Dooming Idol — Numerically quite strong on-use Trinket, but requires tracking the buff
  • Sapling of the Dawnroot — Strong passive Trinket on single-target, loses value on AoE
  • Mindpiercer's Sigil — Decently strong passive Trinket

  • Fang of Umbral Malignance
  • Stormbound Emblem of Dazar
  • Knot of Writhing Serpents
